notes.title: Hoshizora no Memoria -Wish upon a Shooting Star- HD Version Released
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31214042/95aeae67cc7b43cb93624d44baf98fa55a6b57b0.png[/img]

We're pleased to announce that the Hoshizora no Memoria -Wish upon a Shooting Star- HD version is now available on Steam! This includes the updated translation, the ability to change Chinami's voice between the original and Eternal Heart versions, and the engine has been upgraded to use the same one as Hoshizora no Memoria -Eternal Heart- HD. We are still polishing up the game but future updates shouldn't break saves. Chinese text will be added back in the future as a free update. If for any reason you would like to play the old build, swap over to "sd-version" branch on Steam.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/715580/Hoshizora_no_Memoria_Wish_upon_a_Shooting_Star_HD/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2138000/Hoshizora_no_Memoria_Eternal_Heart_HD/

notes.title: Chinese Language Added!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, today we pushed an update to add Chinese language to the game. To access the Chinese version please go to the game in your Steam library, right click to bring up the properties menu, and then click the language tab and select Chinese. Steam will begin to download that version of the game and you'll be able to start playing. We'd also like to extend our thanks to the translation team who brought you this product in Chinese.

notes.title: Updated exe
notes.content:
Beta build we were using for testing has been pushed to live.

One thing that is a issue, your saves will not carry over unless you move them in to a new folder.
To fix that, you need to go to "My Documents\FAVORITE\" and copy everything from "星空のメモリア" to "Hoshizora no Memoria". This should restore your saves.

We are still working on a updated editing pass on the game.
